mapper.select: SELECT cls_ym FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE left(cls_ym,4)=lpad(#{year}::text,4,'0') AND cls_stts_cd='CLOSED' ORDER BY cls_ym

SELECT sls_amt AS revenue,aloc_cst_amt AS project_labor_cost,idle_cst_amt AS idle_cost, drct_expns_amt AS direct_expenses,sls_cst_amt AS cost,grs_prft_amt AS gross_profit, sga_input_amt AS sga_input,indrct_lbr_cst_amt AS indirect_labor_cost,rnd_cst_amt AS rnd_cost, tot_sga_amt AS sga,prvmn_adj_amt AS previous_adjustment,bsn_prft_amt AS operating_profit, nop_incm_amt AS non_operating_income,nop_exp_amt AS non_operating_expenses, corp_tax_amt AS corporate_tax,net_prft_amt AS net_profit,aloc_sls_amt AS allocation_revenue_reference FROM fin.mth_pl WHERE pl_ym=#{month} AND pl_src_cd=#{source}
SELECT fin_se_cd AS category,item_nm AS name,entry_amt AS amount FROM fin.entry WHERE entry_ym=#{month} AND deleted_yn='N' ORDER BY entry_id
SELECT COALESCE(sum(adj_amt),0) FROM cst.prvmn_adj WHERE aply_ym=#{month}
SELECT annl_expc_amt FROM fin.corp_tax_plan WHERE tax_yr=lpad(#{year}::text,4,'0')
SELECT tax_ym AS month,corp_tax_amt AS amount FROM fin.corp_tax_mth WHERE tax_yr=lpad(#{year}::text,4,'0') ORDER BY tax_ym
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cst.mth_cst WHERE cst_ym=#{month}) AS payroll_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM bill.bill WHERE atrb_ym=#{month} AND bill_stts_cd IN ('DRAFT','PLAN')) AS draft_count

SELECT p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract,COALESCE(cd.cd_nm,p.cntrct_ty_cd) AS contract_name, p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name,h.bsn_part_id AS part_id,b.bsn_part_nm AS part_name FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl cd ON cd.cd_grp_id='CONTRACT_TYPE' AND cd.dtl_cd=p.cntrct_ty_cd LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT bsn_part_id FROM prj.prj_part_hist WHERE prj_id=p.prj_id AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC,part_hist_id DESC LIMIT 1) h ON true LEFT JOIN mst.bsn_part b ON b.bsn_part_id=h.bsn_part_id WHERE p.prj_id=#{projectId}

SELECT d.dim_ty_cd AS dimension,d.dim_val AS code, COALESCE(CASE WHEN d.dim_ty_cd='CUSTOMER' THEN c.ptnr_nm WHEN d.dim_ty_cd='PART' THEN b.bsn_part_nm ELSE cd.cd_nm END,d.dim_val) AS name, d.sls_amt AS revenue,d.cst_amt AS cost,d.grs_prft_amt AS gross_profit FROM fin.mth_pl_dtl d LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON d.dim_ty_cd='CUSTOMER' AND c.ptnr_id::text=d.dim_val LEFT JOIN mst.bsn_part b ON d.dim_ty_cd='PART' AND b.bsn_part_id::text=d.dim_val LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl cd ON d.dim_ty_cd='CONTRACT_TYPE' AND cd.cd_grp_id='CONTRACT_TYPE' AND cd.dtl_cd=d.dim_val WHERE d.pl_ym=#{month} ORDER BY d.dim_ty_cd,d.dim_val
